title: Retention rules for derived underwriting artifacts
description: Derived underwriting artifacts created from bank-transaction data must have an owner, a retention classification, documented deletion coverage, and an auditable deletion event. Deletion audit records are retained per the classification in the policy config. Retention durations are defined only in the policy config for this policy version.

requirements.text: Each derived underwriting artifact has a documented owner.
Each derived underwriting artifact stores a retention classification id. The duration for that id is defined only in the policy config.
Deletion coverage must include derived underwriting artifacts, not only raw source documents.
Each deletion of a derived artifact emits an auditable deletion event.
Deletion audit records are retained per the classification in the policy config.
